title: Black car first seen
detail: 4 m before the impact point, moving at 3 km/h (3.6 s before impact).

title: Peak speed 6 ± 4 km/h
detail: Black car was at its fastest 3.2 s before impact. Uncertainty comes from the road calibration (±30%).

title: Could it have stopped?
detail: 1.6 s before impact Black car was at 3 km/h with 1.8 m to go. A full stop (1 s reaction + braking) needs 1.0 m. A stop was possible; the highest speed that would have allowed a stop is about 29 km/h.

title: Braking began 1.5 s before impact
detail: At 3 km/h with 1.7 m left to the impact point. Braking alone needs about 0.1 m to stop from that speed, so a stop was possible.

title: Vision model's reading
detail: The black car was moving slowly and braked suddenly, coming to a stop just before the red car. The red car was parked and was struck by the black car as it moved forward. This agrees with the measurements.

title: Black car at rest
detail: It travelled 0.8 m after the impact and stopped -0.0 s later.

title: Closest approach: Red car
detail: Red car came within 2.8 m of Black car's body (3.8 m centre to centre) at T+0.2 s.
